# noust_application (Data Source)

An application that is already deployed, however it got there: what it runs, where it belongs and in what state, to refer to from other resources. Needs the permission `apps.read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An application someone else deployed: refer to its port or its state without managing it.
data "noust_application" "legacy" {
  domain = "legacy.example.com"
}

output "legacy_port" {
  value = data.noust_application.legacy.port
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The application's primary domain.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the unit is active.
- `app_type` (String) The type of application.
- `branch` (String) The branch it is pinned to, empty when any push deploys.
- `cpu_quota_percent` (Number) CPUQuota in percent of one CPU, empty when unlimited.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the unit starts at boot.
- `environment` (String) The environment it belongs to.
- `health_path` (String) The path its health check probes, empty for the type's own.
- `id` (String) The application's domain.
- `last_commit` (String) The git commit of the newest deployment.
- `last_deployment_id` (Number) The newest deployment of its history.
- `last_deployment_status` (String) The state of the newest deployment: success, failed, running...
- `layout` (String) releases or inplace.
- `memory_max_mb` (Number) MemoryMax in MB, empty when unlimited.
- `path` (String) The application's directory on the server.
- `port` (Number) The port it listens on.
- `project` (String) The project it belongs to.
- `run_as` (String) The account it runs as.
- `source` (String) The address it is deployed from.
- `status` (String) The state of the application's unit: running, stopped, failed or static.
- `tags` (List of String) Its tags.
- `tasks_max` (Number) TasksMax, empty when unlimited.
- `team` (String) The team it belongs to.
- `unit` (String) The systemd unit that runs it.
